title: Grammar 6A Ch 3: Connectives (since / so / so that) & too ... (for ...) to

questions.q: ___ it is raining heavily outside, we have to cancel the picnic.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.9：Since 放在句首表示「既然／由於」（給出已知原因），相當於 Because。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: ___ it is raining heavily outside, we have to cancel the picnic.

questions.q: The box is ___ heavy ___ carry. Can you help me?
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.11：too + 形容詞 + to + 動詞原形（too heavy to carry）表示「太……以致不能……」。

questions.question: The box is ___ heavy ___ carry. Can you help me?

questions.q: This puzzle is ___ difficult ___ my little sister ___ solve.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.12：too + 形容詞 + for + 某人 + to + 動詞原形（too difficult for my little sister to solve）。

questions.question: This puzzle is ___ difficult ___ my little sister ___ solve.

questions.q: The soup is too hot for the baby ___.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.12：too ... for someone 後接 to-infinitive（to drink）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: The soup is too hot for the baby ___.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 3: Connectives (since / so / so that) & too ... (for ...) to

questions.q: Mum turned on the air conditioner ___ the room would be cool.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.9–10：開冷氣的目的是令房間涼快（would be cool），用 so that。

questions.q: Rewrite using 'too ... to' (Grammar 6A p.11): Leo is very tired. He cannot walk any further. -> Leo is ___ tired ___ walk any further.
questions.explain: too tired to walk 表示「太累而走不動」。

questions.q: Rearrange the words to form a correct sentence (Grammar 6A p.12).
questions.explain: 結構：too + 形容詞 (high) + for + 人 (Jenny) + to + 動詞 (reach)。
